sources.title: Watch Jay-Z Bring Out Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg at LA Tour Closer
See Jay-Z Bring Out Snoop Dogg and Dr. Dre for Medley at Los Angeles Show

en.title: Jay‑Z brings Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg to LA show medley
en.dek: Jay‑Z closed his 30‑tour in Los Angeles with a medley featuring Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg, and Too Short, and addressed ticket price rumors.
facts: Jay‑Z performed a medley of “The Next Episode,” “California Love,” “Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang,” and “Still D.R.E.” with Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg.
Too Short joined Jay‑Z for a medley of “Blow the Whistle” and “Blow the Whistle Freestyle.”
Jay‑Z honored Nipsey Hussle with a tribute during the show.
Jay‑Z addressed reports about low‑priced resale tickets during the encore.
body: Jay‑Z closed his 30‑tour at SoFi Stadium on Saturday, the final show of the tour, according to Pitchfork and Rolling Stone. The tour celebrated the 30th anniversary of his debut album Reasonable Doubt.

During the performance, Too Short performed “Blow the Whistle” and Jay‑Z added a freestyle. Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg joined the stage for a medley of “The Next Episode,” “California Love,” “Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang,” and “Still D.R.E.”, according to Rolling Stone.

Jay‑Z honored late rapper Nipsey Hussle by projecting a photo and playing “Hussle & Motivate,” then incorporating “Last Time That I Checc’d” into “On to the Next One.” The tribute was reported by Pitchfork.
Jay‑Z addressed reports that tickets for the show had been sold at low prices. He said, “You gotta be really real with what’s going on in the world,” during the encore, according to Rolling Stone.
en.context: The Jay‑Z 30 tour began earlier in 2026 and celebrated 30 years since his debut album Reasonable Doubt. The Los Angeles stop was the final show of the tour, held at SoFi Stadium. The event featured guest appearances from several artists, including Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg, and Too Short.

de.title: Jay‑Z präsentiert Dr. Dre und Snoop Dogg in einer Medley beim LA‑Auftritt
de.dek: Jay‑Z beendete seine 30‑Tour in Los Angeles mit einer Medley, in der Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg und Too Short zu hören waren, und sprach über Gerüchte zu Ticketpreisen.
facts: Jay‑Z führte eine Medley aus „The Next Episode“, „California Love“, „Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang“ und „Still D.R.E.“ mit Dr. Dre und Snoop Dogg vor.
Too Short trat Jay‑Z bei einer Medley aus „Blow the Whistle“ und „Blow the Whistle Freestyle“ bei.
Jay‑Z ehrte Nipsey Hussle mit einer Hommage während des Auftritts.
Jay‑Z sprach während der Nachspielzeit über Berichte über preisgünstige Weiterverkaufstickets.
body: Jay‑Z beendete seine 30‑Tour am Samstag im SoFi Stadium, der letzten Show der Tour, so Pitchfork und Rolling Stone. Die Tour feierte das 30-jährige Jubiläum seines Debütalbums Reasonable Doubt.

Während der Darbietung spielte Too Short „Blow the Whistle“ und Jay‑Z ergänzte einen Freestyle. Dr. Dre und Snoop Dogg stiegen auf die Bühne, um eine Medley aus „The Next Episode“, „California Love“, „Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang“ und „Still D.R.E.“ zu spielen, so Rolling Stone.

Jay‑Z ehrte den verstorbenen Rapper Nipsey Hussle, indem er ein Foto projizierte und „Hussle & Motivate“ spielte, anschließend „Last Time That I Checc’d“ in „On to the Next One“ einfügte. Die Hommage wurde von Pitchfork berichtet.

Jay‑Z sprach über Berichte, dass Tickets für die Show zu niedrigen Preisen verkauft wurden. Er sagte: „You gotta really real with what’s going on in the world“, während der Nachspielzeit, so Rolling Stone.
de.context: Die Jay‑Z 30‑Tour begann Anfang 2026 und feierte 30 Jahre seit seinem Debütalbum Reasonable Doubt. Der Los‑Angeles‑Stopp war die letzte Show der Tour, die im SoFi Stadium stattfand. Das Ereignis bot Auftritte mehrerer Künstler, darunter Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg und Too Short.

fr.title: Jay‑Z présente Dr. Dre et Snoop Dogg lors d'un medley à Los Angeles
fr.dek: Jay‑Z a clôturé son tour 30 à Los Angeles avec un medley réunissant Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg et Too Short, et a abordé les rumeurs sur les prix des billets.
facts: Jay‑Z a interprété un medley de « The Next Episode », « California Love », « Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang » et « Still D.R.E. » avec Dr. Dre et Snoop Dogg.
Too Short s'est joint à Jay‑Z pour un medley de « Blow the Whistle » et « Blow the Whistle Freestyle ».

body: Jay‑Z a clôturé son tour 30 au SoFi Stadium samedi, le dernier spectacle du tour, selon Pitchfork et Rolling Stone. Le tour célébrait le 30e anniversaire de son premier album, Reasonable Doubt.

Au cours de la performance, Too Short a interprété « Blow the Whistle » et Jay‑Z a ajouté un freestyle. Dr. Dre et Snoop Dogg se sont joints sur scène pour un medley de « The Next Episode », « California Love », « Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang » et « Still D.R.E. », selon Rolling Stone.

Jay‑Z a honoré le rappeur décédé Nipsey Hussle en projetant une photo et en jouant « Hussle & Motivate », puis en incorporant « Last Time That I Checc’d » dans « On to the Next One ». L'hommage a été rapporté par Pitchfork.

Jay‑Z a abordé les rapports indiquant que les billets du spectacle avaient été vendus à bas prix. Il a déclaré : « You gotta be really real with what’s going on in the world », lors de l'enregistrement, selon Rolling Stone.
fr.context: Le tour 30 de Jay‑Z a débuté plus tôt en 2026 et a célébré 30 ans depuis son premier album, Reasonable Doubt. Le passage à Los Angeles était le dernier spectacle du tour, tenu au SoFi Stadium. L'événement a vu la participation d'artistes invités, dont Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg et Too Short.

body: Jay‑Z cerró su tour de 30 años en el SoFi Stadium el sábado, el último espectáculo del tour, según Pitchfork y Rolling Stone. El tour celebró el 30.º aniversario de su álbum debut Reasonable Doubt.

Durante la actuación, Too Short interpretó “Blow the Whistle” y Jay‑Z añadió un freestyle. Dr. Dre y Snoop Dogg se unieron al escenario para un medley de “The Next Episode”, “California Love”, “Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang” y “Still D.R.E.”, según Rolling Stone.

Jay‑Z abordó los informes de que las entradas del espectáculo se habían vendido a precios bajos. Dijo: “You gotta be really real with what’s going on in the world”, durante el encore, según Rolling Stone.

La parada en Los Ángeles fue el último espectáculo del tour, celebrado en el SoFi Stadium. El evento contó con apariciones de varios artistas invitados, entre ellos Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg y Too Short.

body: Jay‑Z chiuse il suo tour dei 30 anni allo SoFi Stadium sabato, l'ultimo spettacolo del tour, secondo Pitchfork e Rolling Stone. Il tour ha celebrato il 30° anniversario del suo album di debutto Reasonable Doubt.

Durante lo spettacolo, Too Short eseguì “Blow the Whistle” e Jay‑Z aggiunse un freestyle. Dr. Dre e Snoop Dogg salirono sul palco per un medley di “The Next Episode,” “California Love,” “Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang,” e “Still D.R.E.”, secondo Rolling Stone.

pt.title: Jay‑Z traz Dr. Dre e Snoop Dogg para medley no show em Los Angeles
pt.dek: Jay‑Z encerrou o seu tour de 30 anos em Los Angeles com um medley com Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg e Too Short, e abordou rumores sobre preços de bilhetes.
facts: Jay‑Z executou um medley de “The Next Episode”, “California Love”, “Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang” e “Still D.R.E.” com Dr. Dre e Snoop Dogg.
Too Short juntou-se a Jay‑Z num medley de “Blow the Whistle” e “Blow the Whistle Freestyle.”
Jay‑Z homenageou Nipsey Hussle com um tributo durante o show.

body: Jay‑Z encerrou o seu tour de 30 anos no SoFi Stadium na sexta-feira, o último show da turnê, segundo Pitchfork e Rolling Stone. A turnê celebrou o 30.º aniversário do seu álbum de estreia Reasonable Doubt.

Durante a apresentação, Too Short executou “Blow the Whistle” e Jay‑Z acrescentou um freestyle. Dr. Dre e Snoop Dogg juntaram-se ao palco num medley de “The Next Episode”, “California Love”, “Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang” e “Still D.R.E.”, segundo Rolling Stone.

Jay‑Z homenageou o falecido rapper Nipsey Hussle ao projetar uma fotografia e tocar “Hussle & Motivate”, depois incorporando “Last Time That I Checc’d” em “On to the Next One”. O tributo foi relatado por Pitchfork.

Jay‑Z abordou relatos de que os bilhetes do show tinham sido vendidos a preços baixos. Ele disse: “You gotta be really real with what’s going on in the world”, durante o encore, segundo Rolling Stone.
pt.context: O tour de 30 anos de Jay‑Z começou no início de 2026 e celebrou 30 anos desde o seu álbum de estreia Reasonable Doubt. A parada em Los Angeles foi o último show da turnê, realizado no SoFi Stadium. O evento contou com participações de vários artistas, entre eles Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg e Too Short.

ja.title: Jay‑Z、Dr. DreとSnoop Doggを招き、LA公演でメドレーを披露
ja.dek: Jay‑Zはロサンゼルスで30年ツアーを締めくくり、Dr. Dre、Snoop Dogg、Too Shortをフィーチャーしたメドレーを披露し、チケット価格の噂に答えた
facts: Jay‑ZはDr. DreとSnoop Doggと共に「The Next Episode」「California Love」「Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang」「Still D.R.E.」のメドレーを披露した
Too ShortはJay‑Zと共に「Blow the Whistle」「Blow the Whistle Freestyle」のメドレーに参加した
Jay‑Zは公演中に亡くなったラッパーNipsey Hussleを称えるトリビュートを行った
Jay‑Zはアンコール中に低価格転売チケットの報道に対処した
body: PitchforkとRolling Stoneによると、Jay‑Zは土曜日にSoFi Stadiumで30年ツアーを締めくくり、ツアーの最終公演を行った。このツアーはデビューアルバム『Reasonable Doubt』30周年を祝った
公演中、Too Shortは「Blow the Whistle」を披露し、Jay‑Zはフリースタイルを加えた。Rolling Stoneによると、Dr. DreとSnoop Doggがステージに登場し、「The Next Episode」「California Love」「Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang」「Still D.R.E.」のメドレーを行った
Jay‑Zは亡くなったラッパーNipsey Hussleを称えるため、写真を投影し「Hussle & Motivate」を再生した後、「Last Time That I Checc’d」を「On to the Next One」に組み込んだ。このトリビュートはPitchforkで報じられた
Jay‑Zは公演のチケットが低価格で転売されているという報道に対し、アンコール中に「You gotta be really real with what’s going on in the world」と語ったとRolling Stoneが報じた
ja.context: Jay‑Z 30年ツアーは2026年初頭に始まり、デビューアルバム『Reasonable Doubt』30周年を祝った。ロサンゼルス公演はツアー最終公演で、SoFi Stadiumで開催された。このイベントにはDr. Dre、Snoop Dogg、Too Shortを含む複数のアーティストがゲスト出演した

zh.title: Jay‑Z在洛杉矶演出中带来Dr. Dre和Snoop Dogg的混合表演
zh.dek: Jay‑Z在洛杉矶以包含Dr. Dre、Snoop Dogg和Too Short的混合表演收官其30周年巡演，并回应门票价格传闻。
facts: Jay‑Z与Dr. Dre和Snoop Dogg合唱了《The Next Episode》《California Love》《Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang》和《Still D.R.E.》的混合表演。
Too Short与Jay‑Z合唱了《Blow the Whistle》和《Blow the Whistle Freestyle》的混合表演。
Jay‑Z在演出中向已故说唱歌手Nipsey Hussle致敬。
Jay‑Z在安可环节回应了关于低价转售门票的报道。
body: 根据Pitchfork和Rolling Stone的报道，Jay‑Z于周六在SoFi体育场以收官演出结束了他的30周年巡回演唱会，这是该巡演的最后一场演出。该巡演纪念他首张专辑《Reasonable Doubt》诞生30周年。
演出期间，Too Short演唱了《Blow the Whistle》，Jay‑Z随后加入即兴表演。根据Rolling Stone的报道，Dr. Dre和Snoop Dogg登台合唱了《The Next Episode》《California Love》《Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang》和《Still D.R.E.》的混合表演。
Jay‑Z通过投影一张Nipsey Hussle的照片并播放《Hussle & Motivate》来向已故说唱歌手Nipsey Hussle致敬，随后将《Last Time That I Checc’d》融入《On to the Next One》之中。Pitchfork报道了此致敬。
Jay‑Z在安可环节回应了关于门票以低价售出的报道。他表示：“你必须对世界上正在发生的事情保持真实。”Rolling Stone报道。
zh.context: Jay‑Z 30周年巡演于2026年初开始，庆祝其首张专辑《Reasonable Doubt》诞生30周年。洛杉矶站点是该巡演的最终演出，地点为SoFi体育场。演出邀请了包括Dr. Dre、Snoop Dogg和Too Short在内的多位艺术家客串。

ko.title: Jay‑Z, 드. 드레와 스눕 도그를 LA 공연 메들리에 끌어들인다
ko.dek: Jay‑Z는 로스앤젤레스에서 30년 투어를 마무리하며 드. 드레, 스눕 도그, 투 쇼트를 포함한 메들리를 선보이고 티켓 가격 루머를 언급했다.
facts: Jay‑Z는 드. 드레와 스눕 도그와 함께 “The Next Episode,” “California Love,” “Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang,” “Still D.R.E.”를 섞은 메들리를 연주했다.
투 쇼트는 Jay‑Z와 함께 “Blow the Whistle”와 “Blow the Whistle Freestyle”를 섞은 메들리에 참여했다.
Jay‑Z는 공연 중 사망한 래퍼 니프시 허슬을 기리며 헌사를 했다.
Jay‑Z는 앵콜 중에 저가 재판매 티켓에 대한 보도를 언급했다.
body: Pitchfork와 Rolling Stone에 따르면 Jay‑Z는 토요일 SoFi Stadium에서 30년 투어를 마무리하며 투어 마지막 공연을 선보였다. 이 투어는 그의 데뷔 앨범 Reasonable Doubt의 30주년을 기념했다.
공연 중 투 쇼트는 “Blow the Whistle”를 연주했고 Jay‑Z는 프리스타일을 추가했다. 드. 드레와 스눕 도그는 Rolling Stone에 따르면 “The Next Episode,” “California Love,” “Nuthin’ But a ‘G’ Thang,” “Still D.R.E.”를 섞은 메들리를 위해 무대에 합류했다.
Jay‑Z는 Pitchfork에 따르면 사망한 래퍼 니프시 허슬을 기리며 사진을 투사하고 “Hussle & Motivate”를 연주한 뒤 “Last Time That I Checc’d”를 “On to the Next One”에 통합했다.
Jay‑Z는 Rolling Stone에 따르면 공연 티켓이 저가로 판매되었다는 보도를 언급하며 앵콜 중에 “You gotta be really real with what’s going on in the world,”라고 말했다.
ko.context: Jay‑Z 30년 투어는 2026년 초에 시작되었으며, 그의 데뷔 앨범 Reasonable Doubt의 30주년을 기념했다. 로스앤젤레스 공연은 SoFi Stadium에서 열렸으며, 투어 마지막 공연이었다. 이 행사는 드. 드레, 스눕 도그, 투 쇼트 등 여러 아티스트의 게스트 출연을 포함했다.
